items.title: Constellation reports Q3 results and new nuclear power agreements
items.summary: Constellation reported Q3 adjusted operating EPS of $5.06 and narrowed 2026 guidance to $12.50–$12.80. It disclosed a Google nuclear collaboration, a 20-year 270 MW agreement and a conditional DOE commitment up to $5 billion. These strengthen long-duration power demand visibility, while financing and execution remain conditional.
items.key_finding: Power contracting and conditional financing support the nuclear growth pipeline; delivery remains subject to execution.

items.title: NRG announces $4 billion sale of 4.9 GW gas generation
items.summary: NRG agreed to sell six gas-fired generation assets totaling 4.9 GW to LS Power for $4 billion, subject to regulatory approvals and a targeted Q2 2027 closing. It reported Q3 adjusted EPS of $4.68 and said its separate 1.2 GW data-center power project remains on track. The sale reallocates capital rather than shutting down generation.

observations.label: Premarket price response
observations.value: Approximately +6.4%, media report; not official close

items.key_finding: Material power-asset monetization with an intact data-center project; regulatory closing remains the principal uncertainty.

sources.title: Wall Street Journal earnings and price reaction

items.title: Immunovant meets 600 mg rheumatoid arthritis trial primary endpoint
items.summary: IMVT-1402 at 600 mg met its Week 28 primary endpoint with 92.5% ACR20 response versus 75.6% placebo (p=0.0139) after an open-label lead-in. The 300 mg arm did not significantly outperform placebo. The result supports development, but the enriched withdrawal design and pending FDA discussions limit certainty.

observations.label: Premarket response
observations.value: Approximately +14%, early report; not official close

items.key_finding: Positive higher-dose clinical signal with important study-design and dose-response caveats.

items.title: Ionis cuts Tryngolza annual sales guidance
items.summary: Ionis reduced 2026 Tryngolza sales guidance from $100–110 million to approximately $50 million as commercialization ramps more slowly than expected. Company-wide revenue guidance remains $875–900 million. The product-specific miss is material despite offsets elsewhere, and the next prescription and sales data will test whether it is temporary.

observations.label: Premarket price response
observations.value: Approximately -9.8% in early report; not official close

items.key_finding: Tryngolza launch underperformance is a material fundamental negative, partially offset by unchanged group guidance.

items.title: Brent and WTI decline on Iran de-escalation talk despite serious Hormuz security warnings
items.summary: Reuters reported Brent down 1.7% to $96.67 and WTI down 1.0% to $89.87 at 08:30 GMT as U.S. comments lowered expectations of renewed Iran strikes. UKMTO's November 8 notices document tanker security incidents, but no new physical oil-volume loss was established. Last week's approximately 16% Brent decline underscores the market's de-escalation pricing despite unresolved maritime risk.

observations.label: Price observation time
observations.value: November 9, 2026 at 08:30 GMT / 3:30 AM EST; intraday futures quote

observations.label: Physical oil supply loss
observations.value: No new incremental loss verified from the reviewed shipping incidents

items.key_finding: Oil prices are responding to diplomatic signals while confirmed shipping-security risks persist; physical transit normalization is not yet demonstrated.
